definitions.explanation: A machine that automatically washes dishes. Short for {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き}. Increasingly common in Japanese households.

examples.japanese: {食洗機|しょくせんき}に{入|い}れる。
うちの{食洗機|しょくせんき}は{静|しず}かで{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Our dishwasher is quiet and convenient.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しいキッチンには{食洗機|しょくせんき}が{備|そな}え{付|つ}けてある。
examples.english: The new kitchen has a built-in dishwasher.

notes:
Abbreviation of {食器洗|しょっきあら}い{機|き} (dish-washing machine). This shortened form is the most common way to refer to a dishwasher in everyday conversation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}{対応|たいおう} — dishwasher-safe
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}に{入|い}れる — to load the dishwasher
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}を{回|まわ}す — to run the dishwasher
- {食洗機|しょくせんき}{用|よう}{洗剤|せんざい} — dishwasher detergent
- ビルトイン{食洗機|しょくせんき} — built-in dishwasher

USAGE:
While traditionally less common in Japanese homes than in Western countries, dishwashers have become increasingly popular. Product labels and instructions often use {食洗機|しょくせんき}{対応|たいおう} to indicate an item is dishwasher-safe.
